title: helperReferences
responsibility: Reads helper import bindings, runtime references and forwarding exports from committed source.

inputs.name: helperReferences.code
inputs.description: TypeScript or JavaScript source text to inspect for actual runtime references and export forwarding.
examples: import { slugify } from './slugify'; export function title() { return slugify('Hello'); }

inputs.name: helperReferences.svelte
inputs.description: Whether code is a Svelte component. When true, inspect its script blocks and real template expressions; defaults to false.

outputs.name: helperReferences
outputs.description: Binding references with their named callers, plus forwarded export bindings. The facts contain names and module specifiers, not retained syntax trees.
